next.reason: Both make 9x an implementor-defined unsuccessful condition with x set by the implementor; 1985 'must not duplicate any condition specified for the I-O status values 00 through 49' and §2023:9.1.13.11 GR1 'shall not duplicate any other condition specified by another I-O status value' bound it the same way for a program. The A.1 documentation item is an implementor obligation, not part of this rule.
